hooks.command: input=$(cat); if cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then printf '%s' "$input" | .venv/bin/python -m verdict_agent.guard --mode strict || exit 2; else case "$input" in *ab_tests_stop*|*ab_tests_replace*|*placements_update*|*ab-tests*stop*|*ab-tests*replace*|*ab-tests*archive*) echo "verdict guard unavailable (repository or .venv missing): run scripts/setup.sh" >&2; exit 2;; esac; fi
